controls.title: Name the accountable owner
controls.requirement: Assign a business owner and a technical owner for each AI workflow, including experiments that access company data.
controls.verification: Select a running workflow and confirm who can stop it and who accepts its residual risk.
controls.evidence: Approved ownership record and escalation contact.

controls.title: Inventory the complete workflow
controls.requirement: Record models, gateways, tools, plugins, MCP servers, storage, dependencies, identities, data sources and execution locations.
controls.verification: Trace one real request from user input to output and every external action; compare it with the inventory.
controls.evidence: Dated inventory and data-flow diagram.

controls.title: Classify data before connecting it
controls.requirement: Define which data classes may enter each model, connector, index, browser session and log destination.
controls.verification: Use synthetic examples of allowed and prohibited data and verify the documented handling decision.
controls.evidence: Data classification matrix and approved use cases.

controls.title: Document trust boundaries
controls.requirement: Identify where untrusted content, executable code or a different user or tenant crosses into a more privileged component.
controls.verification: Walk through a malicious document, compromised package and stolen token; identify the enforced boundary for each.
controls.evidence: Threat model with controls and unresolved risks.

controls.title: Make approved AI easy to use
controls.requirement: Maintain approved tools and a clear process for requesting new tools, reporting accidental uploads and retiring unused integrations.
controls.verification: Ask a team member to find the policy and report a synthetic accidental upload without using a public channel.
controls.evidence: Approved-tools list, onboarding record and reporting procedure.

controls.title: Reassess meaningful changes
controls.requirement: Require review when adding a data source, tool, model, privilege, network route or execution backend; give exceptions an expiry.
controls.verification: Review the last material change and confirm its tests and risk acceptance; find any expired exceptions.
controls.evidence: Change record and dated exception register.

controls.title: Inventory credentials without collecting their values
controls.requirement: Record each credential's owner, purpose, scope, storage location, consumers, expiry and revocation method.
controls.verification: Sample one credential per integration and follow its lifecycle without printing its value.
controls.evidence: Redacted credential register.

controls.title: Separate identities and environments
controls.requirement: Use distinct service identities for development, staging, production, workloads and tenants where their access must differ.
controls.verification: Try a staging identity against a production test resource; confirm denial and absence of shared administrator keys.
controls.evidence: Permission matrix and redacted denial event.

controls.title: Limit credential scope and lifetime
controls.requirement: Prefer workload identity and short-lived credentials; constrain resources and operations, and justify any long-lived key.
controls.verification: Attempt an out-of-scope operation with a test identity and verify expiry or revocation terminates access.
controls.evidence: Policy, token lifetime and test results.

controls.title: Keep secrets out of published and retained content
controls.requirement: Exclude credentials from prompts, repositories, image layers, build output, traces, shell history and assessment evidence.
controls.verification: Scan a synthetic test fixture through the actual build and logging paths; verify findings and redaction without using live keys.
controls.evidence: Scan results and sanitized logging samples.

controls.title: Keep reusable secrets outside agent execution
controls.requirement: Use a trusted tool service or credential broker when possible. An environment variable or mounted secret is readable by code with sufficient access inside that environment.
controls.verification: In a disposable test environment, inspect only known synthetic secret locations and verify that reusable provider credentials are absent from the agent's view.
controls.evidence: Architecture, allowed credential exceptions and synthetic isolation test.

controls.title: Constrain the credential broker itself
controls.requirement: Bind each broker operation to an authenticated caller, approved destination, account, method and resource. Do not forward credentials across arbitrary redirects.
controls.verification: Try a wrong destination, cross-account request, redirected request and revoked caller using test credentials; each unauthorized case must fail.
controls.evidence: Broker policy and negative-test results.

controls.title: Prove revocation works
controls.requirement: Provide a documented emergency path for revoking keys, sessions, refresh tokens, workload trust and derived access.
controls.verification: Revoke a disposable credential, then retry from an existing session and a new session; measure the effective cutoff.
controls.evidence: Timed revocation drill and list of dependent credentials.

controls.title: Block unnecessary metadata credentials
controls.requirement: Prevent untrusted workloads from reaching cloud metadata and container credential services unless specifically required; minimize any attached workload role.
controls.verification: Use an isolated test setup to verify network denial and inspect the effective identity policy; never collect production metadata tokens as evidence.
controls.evidence: Egress policy, workload role and test result.

controls.title: Lock the full dependency graph
controls.requirement: Use reviewed lockfiles for direct and transitive packages, verified artifact hashes where supported, and container digests. A pinned malicious release remains malicious.
controls.verification: Build in a clean environment using the enforced lockfile mode and compare the resolved manifest with the reviewed one.
controls.evidence: Lockfile, artifact digest and build manifest.

controls.title: Treat build and security tools as production dependencies
controls.requirement: Review and pin CI actions and scanners; use full commit identifiers for actions and verified immutable artifacts where available.
controls.verification: Inspect every workflow, including reusable workflows, for moving tags or unreviewed downloads; verify the referenced upstream repository.
controls.evidence: Workflow inventory and reviewed immutable references.

controls.title: Separate untrusted builds from release credentials
controls.requirement: Run pull requests, dependency builds and third-party scanners without publishing or production credentials. Grant release access only in a protected stage.
controls.verification: Run a synthetic untrusted contribution and confirm it cannot obtain a release token, edit protected artifacts or trigger an authorized release.
controls.evidence: Job permission map and release-stage test.

controls.title: Protect publishing identity
controls.requirement: Use short-lived release identity where supported, strong maintainer authentication and restricted repository, workflow, ref and environment trust.
controls.verification: Attempt a release from an unapproved ref using a test package or dry-run target; verify denial.
controls.evidence: Release policy and negative authorization test.

controls.title: Verify artifact origin and integrity
controls.requirement: Use approved registries and publishers; validate signatures or provenance where provided and inspect changes between reviewed source and distributed artifacts.
controls.verification: Select one deployed artifact and link its digest to the reviewed release and build provenance; document gaps.
controls.evidence: Artifact origin record and verification output.

controls.title: Review model and plugin installation behavior
controls.requirement: Treat model loaders, custom model code, install hooks, IDE extensions, skills and local MCP packages as executable software.
controls.verification: Inspect manifests and installation behavior in a disposable environment with synthetic data; identify network access and executable hooks.
controls.evidence: Component review and approved install procedure.

controls.title: Update deliberately and promptly
controls.requirement: Assign patch ownership, monitor advisories, set risk-based deadlines and test upgrades with rollback. Dependency locking must not become permanent stagnation.
controls.verification: Take a relevant advisory through triage, affected-version discovery, staging checks and rollout or documented mitigation.
controls.evidence: Patch register, deployment inventory and rollback record.

controls.title: Rebuild compromised environments
controls.requirement: For suspected malicious dependencies, quarantine affected runners, caches, images and environments; preserve evidence, revoke exposed access and rebuild from trusted inputs.
controls.verification: Tabletop a poisoned dependency: identify all builds and downstream artifacts, then demonstrate clean rebuild and credential revocation paths.
controls.evidence: Artifact lineage and recovery exercise.

controls.title: Restrict inbound reachability
controls.requirement: Keep model, tool, database and management endpoints on approved interfaces and networks. Review port publishing, tunnels, load balancers and IPv6 as well as IPv4.
controls.verification: From authorized external and internal test vantage points, verify that only intended paths are reachable, including direct backend addresses.
controls.evidence: Endpoint inventory and reachability results.

controls.title: Authenticate every protected entry point
controls.requirement: Enforce authentication and authorization on inference, administration, uploads, model management, tools and debugging endpoints. Test direct paths around the gateway.
controls.verification: Send no-credential, invalid-credential and low-privilege requests to test endpoints; protected operations must fail without performing work.
controls.evidence: Route-to-policy map and negative-test results.

controls.title: Separate administration from ordinary use
controls.requirement: Give configuration, model import, backend installation, tool registration and credential management their own restricted administrative permissions.
controls.verification: Use a regular user identity to attempt a harmless configuration change in staging; verify denial independently of the UI.
controls.evidence: Role matrix and denied admin test.

controls.title: Control outbound connections
controls.requirement: Allow only destinations and operations required for the workflow; include DNS, direct IP access, proxies, redirects and alternate protocols in the design.
controls.verification: Use synthetic traffic to approved and disallowed test destinations from the actual workload identity and network namespace.
controls.evidence: Egress rules and allow/deny observations.

controls.title: Defend URL-fetching paths
controls.requirement: Validate resolved destinations and redirects for fetch tools, imports, previews, webhooks and authorization discovery; prevent unintended access to private services.
controls.verification: Use controlled fixtures for private, loopback, link-local, redirect and DNS-change cases; verify blocking without querying real sensitive endpoints.
controls.evidence: SSRF test record and destination policy.

controls.title: Protect transport and browser access
controls.requirement: Use validated encrypted transport across relevant boundaries; set narrow browser origins and host checks, and CSRF protection for cookie-authenticated changes.
controls.verification: Test an invalid certificate, unexpected origin or host, and a forged state-changing request; confirm rejection. CORS is not authentication.
controls.evidence: TLS configuration and browser negative tests.

controls.title: Limit resource consumption
controls.requirement: Enforce per-identity and per-tenant request, token, concurrency, upload, execution-time and spend limits; alert before exhaustion.
controls.verification: Apply a small agreed load in staging; verify throttling, cancellation and cost controls without affecting production.
controls.evidence: Limit configuration and bounded load-test results.

controls.title: Authorize actions outside the model
controls.requirement: Enforce tool, operation and resource permissions in trusted code using the real caller's authority. Model text and tool descriptions must not grant access.
controls.verification: Request a harmless out-of-scope action and verify the tool service rejects it even when the model proposes it.
controls.evidence: Policy decision and denied tool call.

controls.title: Require precise approval for high-impact actions
controls.requirement: For payments, deletion, permission changes, publishing or external messages, show the exact target and material payload or diff before approval; bind approval to that action and expiry.
controls.verification: Change the target or payload after a test approval, replay it, or let it expire; the executor must reject the altered or stale request.
controls.evidence: Approval record and integrity tests.

controls.title: Treat retrieved instructions as untrusted data
controls.requirement: Emails, pages, images, documents, repository files, skills and tool responses cannot override authorization. Use content screening as an additional layer.
controls.verification: Place a benign instruction to cross a test boundary in an external document; verify no unauthorized action or data access occurs.
controls.evidence: Injection regression case and tool audit trail.

controls.title: Review integrations and permission changes
controls.requirement: Approve each tool server, publisher, endpoint, local command, declared capability and update path; re-review changes in behavior or requested scope.
controls.verification: Compare deployed integrations with the approved inventory and simulate a changed tool description or newly requested permission.
controls.evidence: Integration manifest and change review.

controls.title: Keep tool sessions bound to identities
controls.requirement: For remote integrations, validate token audience, issuer, expiry and scopes; bind session handles to the user and client. Apply explicit consent where acting for users.
controls.verification: Try another user's session handle, a token for a different audience and a revoked grant in staging; all must fail.
controls.evidence: Auth configuration and cross-user tests.

controls.title: Validate tool arguments and results
controls.requirement: Use schemas plus business rules for paths, amounts, recipients and resource identifiers; use safe APIs instead of concatenating model text into shell or SQL.
controls.verification: Submit malformed inputs and validly shaped but unauthorized values; verify rejection before any side effect.
controls.evidence: Validation tests and safe execution interface.

controls.title: Constrain autonomy and handoffs
controls.requirement: Set step, retry, time and cost budgets; preserve the initiating user's permissions across agent handoffs and require a working cancel path.
controls.verification: Trigger a bounded loop and a handoff to a more privileged test agent; verify termination and no privilege expansion.
controls.evidence: Run limits, cancellation event and delegation tests.

controls.title: Contain the entire execution path
controls.requirement: Evaluate the agent harness, internal helpers, shell, Git, file tools, plugin subprocesses and browser workers as part of the execution boundary.
controls.verification: Run benign boundary tests through multiple tool and background-helper paths, not only the shell; inspect where child processes execute.
controls.evidence: Process-boundary diagram and test matrix.

controls.title: Share only necessary host resources
controls.requirement: Avoid mounting the host root, home directory, credentials, browser profile, SSH agent or container daemon socket into untrusted workloads. Scope required mounts and prefer read-only access.
controls.verification: Inspect effective mounts, inherited environment and reachable sockets; verify a synthetic host-only file remains inaccessible.
controls.evidence: Sanitized mount/socket inventory and canary test.

controls.title: Keep enforcement outside untrusted execution
controls.requirement: Keep authorization state, broker secrets and control-plane interfaces outside memory and storage readable or writable by the agent; authenticate every privileged request.
controls.verification: Verify that synthetic enforcement secrets and policy files are absent from the guest and that forged control requests are rejected.
controls.evidence: Control-plane design and access tests.

controls.title: Reduce operating-system privileges
controls.requirement: Run with the least required user and capabilities; restrict unnecessary syscalls, namespaces, devices and kernel modules. Test compatibility before tightening.
controls.verification: Compare effective privileges with the workload's requirements and exercise denied operations in a disposable environment.
controls.evidence: Runtime profile and compatibility test.

controls.title: Test file boundaries beyond path strings
controls.requirement: Constrain file and patch operations using resolved, authorized resources; account for symlinks, nested directories, renames and changes between validation and use.
controls.verification: Use benign fixtures for traversal, symlink redirection and renamed parents; confirm reads and writes stay within the intended workspace.
controls.evidence: Filesystem boundary tests and affected-version record.

controls.title: Patch every isolation layer
controls.requirement: Track the host OS, guest OS, runtime, hypervisor, filesystem-sharing layer, agent and extensions; an updated application can still use an old guest image.
controls.verification: Compare running versions and image digests against approved baselines and applicable vendor advisories.
controls.evidence: Runtime version inventory and patch evidence.

controls.title: Separate sessions and clean up reuse
controls.requirement: Isolate users and tenants across disks, memory, temporary files, browser state and snapshots. Define cleanup for recycled environments and failed jobs.
controls.verification: Run two disposable identities in sequence with synthetic markers and verify the second cannot retrieve the first's data; review infrastructure erasure guarantees.
controls.evidence: Session isolation tests and storage lifecycle policy.

controls.title: Minimize the data sent to each component
controls.requirement: Send only fields needed for the task; redact or tokenize sensitive values before external processing where the workflow allows it.
controls.verification: Trace a synthetic request through model, tool, telemetry and retry paths and compare every field with the approved data flow.
controls.evidence: Redacted trace and minimization rules.

controls.title: Check actual provider data settings
controls.requirement: Document retention, training use, support access, subprocessors, processing locations and deletion behavior for the exact service, account tier and features used.
controls.verification: Inspect account settings and applicable service terms; test deletion where supported and record exceptions such as abuse-monitoring retention.
controls.evidence: Dated settings and vendor review.

controls.title: Enforce retrieval permissions before generation
controls.requirement: Apply current user and tenant permissions to documents, chunks, metadata and retrieval queries; never rely on the model to hide unauthorized context.
controls.verification: Give two synthetic users different document rights; test direct retrieval and generated answers for cross-user access.
controls.evidence: ACL mapping and retrieval negative tests.

controls.title: Isolate memory, caches and sessions
controls.requirement: Scope conversation history, retrieval caches, embeddings and saved memory to their intended identity and purpose; validate what may become persistent memory.
controls.verification: Repeat similar requests across test tenants and inject an untrusted memory instruction; verify no data or authority crosses boundaries.
controls.evidence: Cache-key design and memory/session tests.

controls.title: Control retention and deletion end to end
controls.requirement: Define lifetimes for uploads, prompts, outputs, traces, embeddings, temporary files, snapshots and backups; document how deletions and permission removals propagate.
controls.verification: Delete a synthetic document and revoke access; verify active copies disappear and backup handling follows the documented schedule.
controls.evidence: Retention matrix and deletion/revocation test.

controls.title: Validate outputs before downstream use
controls.requirement: Treat model output as untrusted at rendering, export and execution boundaries; sanitize active content, enforce destination permissions and review sensitive disclosures.
controls.verification: Use synthetic active markup, formula-like export cells and sensitive markers; confirm safe rendering/export and blocked unauthorized delivery.
controls.evidence: Output handling tests and release checks.

controls.title: Protect ingestion and model assets
controls.requirement: Restrict who can change datasets, retrieval indexes, model files and configuration; record origin, version and integrity and quarantine untrusted uploads.
controls.verification: Try an unauthorized index change and process a benign malformed upload in staging; verify denial or isolation and traceability.
controls.evidence: Ingestion policy, dataset lineage and version record.

controls.title: Log attributable security events
controls.requirement: Record user and workload identities, tool operations, targets, policy decisions, approvals, versions and timestamps with correlation IDs; redact content and secrets.
controls.verification: Trace one permitted and one denied test request across components without relying on the model's own narrative.
controls.evidence: Sanitized event chain and log access policy.

controls.title: Alert on meaningful changes and misuse
controls.requirement: Monitor new exposed endpoints, unusual credential use, privilege changes, disabled controls, unexpected egress, repeated denials and spend spikes.
controls.verification: Trigger selected low-impact synthetic events and verify alerts reach an accountable responder.
controls.evidence: Alert rules, routing and drill results.

controls.title: Provide independent containment controls
controls.requirement: Maintain a trusted way to stop tool execution, revoke identities, restrict network access and quarantine environments even if the agent is unresponsive.
controls.verification: Stop a benign long-running staging task from outside the agent; verify both current and newly queued actions cease.
controls.evidence: Timed containment test and operator procedure.

controls.title: Prepare the credential-exposure response
controls.requirement: Plan containment, evidence preservation, clean-device revocation, session invalidation, persistence review, clean rebuild and downstream impact analysis.
controls.verification: Exercise the incident playbook with a fake exposed key and a compromised-dependency scenario; record decisions and gaps.
controls.evidence: Incident exercise and revised runbook.

controls.title: Prove recovery and rollback
controls.requirement: Back up necessary configuration and data with restricted access; test restoration into a clean environment and prevent revoked secrets from returning.
controls.verification: Restore a synthetic workload from backup, verify permissions and integrity, and ensure old credentials remain unusable.
controls.evidence: Restore report and recovery objectives.

controls.title: Repeat security acceptance tests
controls.requirement: Rerun applicable tests after material changes and on a documented schedule; keep versioned evidence and track unresolved findings.
controls.verification: Select the most recent release and verify tests match its actual versions, integrations and permissions.
controls.evidence: Acceptance-test report and remediation backlog.

controls.title: Verify assurance scope and issuer
controls.requirement: Review actual audit reports, certification scope, dates, exclusions and independent issuers; verify that the deployed service and relevant controls are covered.
controls.verification: Match a supplier claim to the underlying current report and identify customer responsibilities and unresolved findings.
controls.evidence: Vendor assessment and report review.

controls.title: Establish tenant-storage isolation
controls.requirement: For shared infrastructure, obtain evidence of allocation, deletion, reuse and snapshot isolation; assess per-tenant key separation where supported. Disk encryption alone does not prove tenant isolation.
controls.verification: Review the provider's or platform team's isolation design and assurance evidence; run only authorized synthetic tenant tests within your own scope.
controls.evidence: Storage isolation review and accepted residual risk.

controls.title: Define security change and incident communication
controls.requirement: Identify who receives vendor advisories, how affected versions are located and when incident notifications reach your team.
controls.verification: Route a sample advisory to the owner and find affected deployments from the inventory.
controls.evidence: Notification contacts and response workflow.

controls.title: Plan exit and offboarding
controls.requirement: Document connector removal, identity revocation, data export/deletion, retention exceptions and operational fallback when a provider or plugin is removed.
controls.verification: Offboard a disposable integration and confirm both access termination and data-lifecycle follow-through.
controls.evidence: Exit checklist and test record.
